content.question: What is Cameroon Pidgin English?
content.answer: An English-based pidgin, also called Kamtok, that serves as a language of wider communication across Cameroon.

content.question: Is Cameroon Pidgin English an official language?
content.answer: No. It is less prestigious than English and French but felt to be more African.

content.question: How many people speak Cameroon Pidgin English?
content.answer: It is hard to say, because speakers range from first-language speakers to people who use it only occasionally.
